about.title: About Me
about.intro: Six-plus years delivering production-grade web platforms and digital products for global brands — available for freelance projects and open to full-time engagements.
about.experience: My work spans global brands: 3D product configurators for Volvo and Jeep, checkout infrastructure at adidas supporting transactions across 30+ countries, and real-time architectural visualizations for Amarilo and other real estate leaders through Umbra 3D Studio. I work across the full stack — from React, Three.js and Angular on the frontend to Node.js, CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes on the systems side. Nowadays working with an AI-augmented workflow (Claude Code, Gemini, NotebookLM) to ship faster without cutting corners on quality.
about.tagline: I write code in OOP; I think in Matrix 4x4; I celebrate in salsa.
